name: Call of Earth

angles.text: This rite represents an essential communion for shamans, binding spirit to stone and granting vision beyond mortal perception through the ritual draught of sapta.
Spoken in the rough cadence of dwarven speech amid frozen mountain peaks, this sacred communion ties communion with the earth directly to Dun Morogh's snowy heights.
The presence of an elemental rite in the snowy mountain crags shows shamanic traditions taking root within Alliance lands.

faq.answer: Earth Sapta is a potent mystical brew crafted with magic to bind a practitioner's spirit directly to the elements. It is not intended for the weak-willed, as drinking it pierces ordinary mortal sight and reveals spirits and elemental truths that others cannot perceive.

The brew must be consumed only at a dedicated sacred site. In this rite, the practitioner is directed north up the mountain along a hidden path to locate the ancient Spirit Stone tucked away in the crags.
faq.q: Where must the sapta be consumed?

faq.answer: The Call of Earth is a foundational trial of communion and humility. By drinking the sapta at the Spirit Stone, the initiate learns to draw strength from the mountains, patience from the plains, and attune their mortal spirit to the living world before facing more turbulent elements.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the Call of Earth rite?

faq.answer: Only a select few initiated shamans possess the knowledge and spiritual preparation required to brew sapta. Its recipe is guarded and treated with great reverence, as the draught connects mortal awareness directly to primal forces.
faq.q: Who knows how to brew Earth Sapta?

aliases: how does earth compare to fire water air
faq.answer: While other elemental forces clash, burn, and roar with violent unrest, the earth element represents steadfast stillness, patience, and unyielding foundation. Initiates must first learn humility before the stone before confronting the volatile dual nature of the other elements.
faq.q: How does the element of earth differ from the other elements?

aliases: where is call of earth set
faq.answer: The quest takes place high in a cold, snowbound mountain range, where initiates follow an secluded path winding through the snow and stone to commune with the spirits of the land despite the biting frost.
faq.q: What setting is this rite performed in?

sections.body: The Call of Earth is a sacred trial of spiritual attunement, requiring an initiate to drink the enchanted brew known as Earth Sapta at an isolated mountain shrine. Forged through ancient elemental magic, sapta binds the drinker's spirit to the bedrock of the world, granting mortal eyes the rare power to witness elemental spirits and subtle currents invisible to ordinary sight. Because of its potency, the draught must only be consumed in a designated holy site where the bond between spirit and stone can safely take hold.
sections.title: The Draught of Vision

sections.body: High up a snow-swept mountain, tucked away at the terminus of a secluded hidden path, rests the Spirit Stone. Initiates journey into this bitter, frozen landscape to stand humbly before the ancient rock. By presenting themselves without pride and imbibing the sapta, they discover that even in the harshest winter crags, the living earth extends its welcome. The mountains become a foundation of enduring physical strength, while the vast, steady plains teach the quiet power of patience.
sections.title: The Spirit Stone in the Snow

sections.body: Communing with stone serves as a foundational rite for spiritual pathfinders. Unlike the restless fury of wind, fire, or crashing water, the earth teaches unmoving discipline and quiet resilience. To pass the rite, the seeker must absorb the earth's quiet essence, preparing their mind and body for the conflicting, chaotic dualities of the more volatile elements that roar across the world.
sections.title: Strength and Stillness

summary: The Call of Earth is a sacred shamanic rite that binds an initiate's mortal spirit to the enduring foundations of the world. By imbibing the visionary brew known as Earth Sapta at a secluded mountain Spirit Stone, the seeker learns humility, patience, and elemental awareness amid the snow and rock.
